name: Autoclave
description: Escape is the only objective in this atmospheric, isometric 3D horror game. Rotate your camera view to uncover hidden passages, manipulate heavy machinery, and find the exit of a locked underground facility.

name: Galactic Intervention
description: Forge your empire among the stars in Galactic Intervention, the ultimate massively multiplayer space strategy browser game. Command a fleet of massive warships, align with powerful galactic factions, and engage in tactical space battles with thousands of players simultaneously.

name: Terminal Snake
description: Classic snake in terminal style — keyboard, swipe or on-screen pad. Speeds up as you grow; your high score stays in your browser.

name: Breach Protocol
description: Hacking puzzle: pick codes along rows and columns to upload daemon sequences before your buffer runs out.
